sloka: रामाद् विशिष्टः को ऽन्यो ऽस्ति कश्चित् सौमित्रिणा समः ।अग्निमारुतकल्पौ तौ भ्रातरौ तव संश्रयौ ।। ५.३९.५३।।।।
transliteration: rāmād viśiṣṭaḥ ko 'nyo 'sti kaścit saumitriṇā samaḥ ।agnimārutakalpau tau bhrātarau tava saṁśrayau ।। 5.39.53।।।।

translations.english: "Who is superior to Rama? Who is equal to Lakshmana? Both the brothers are like Fire and Wind. They are your refuge.
